digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, LLM runner, verdict coverage reporting
propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures (e.g., overlap-judge batch calls timing out) are logged but invisible in plan-review verdict JSON, making silent degradation undetectable to callers.
An empty overlap[] result is byte-identical whether caused by actual no-overlap or by every batch call failing, creating false equivalence between healthy and degraded runs.
The runner seam (PydanticAIRunner.run exception block) records all failures to a JSONL spend log but carries nothing into the in-memory verdict object.

A new run-scoped observability sink must record survived LLM step failures keyed by call label and drain them into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation safety for clean runs.
The sink must activate in the plan-review run scope and be recorded at the single runner seam without changing any swallow site behavior, retry logic, or verdict classification.
